newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - San Mateo County Transit District.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Mateo County Transit District.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the San Mateo County Transit District (the District'' o County, California, intends to offer for public sale on
at the hour of 10:00 a.m., California time, at the office o Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105,
$70,000,000* principal amount of bonds designated San Mateo County Transit District Limited Tax Bonds, 1997 Series A'' (the

suant to an Indenture, dated as of December 1, 1990, as amended and supplemented, including as amended and supplemented by a Third Supplemental Indenture, to be dated as of August 1, 1997, by and between First Trust of California, National Association, as successor trustee, and the District. The date of the sale of the 1997 Bonds may be changed to a later date established by the General Manager of the District and communicated through Munifacts News Service and Bloomberg's Financial News Wire not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be received. If no legal bid is accepted for the 1997 Bonds on August 5, 1997 at the time and place specified, bids will be received for the 1997 Bonds at such other place and time as determined by the General Manager of the District and communicated through Munifacts News Service and Bloomberg's Financial News Wire.

NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the 1997 Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale for the 1997 Bonds, and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the 1997 Bonds will be furnished upon request to Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, telephone number (415) 979-0300.
